summary: Zenta Group Company Limited, a Macau-based foreign private issuer listed on a US exchange, filed this Form 6-K to report the completed acquisition of 100% of ZentoAI Intelligent Technology Company Limited, which closed September 11, 2026. Consideration comprised HKD10,000,000 in cash plus 12,278,340 Class A ordinary shares issued to the selling shareholders. Post-closing, Zenta has 24,087,179 ordinary shares outstanding: 17,719,499 Class A and 6,367,680 Class B. The share consideration roughly doubles the prior share count, creating meaningful dilution. No board recommendation, advisor, earnout, or lockup terms disclosed. Watch resale registration or lockup expiry for potential overhang, and any trading reaction as markets absorb the equity issuance.
